scripts.build: npm run build:desk && npm run build:rachawatsadu && npm run build:store && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:desk: cd desk-app && npm ci && VITE_BASE_PATH=/desk/ npm run build && rm -rf ../public/desk && mkdir -p ../public/desk && cp -r dist/. ../public/desk/ && touch ../public/desk/.nojekyll
scripts.build:rachawatsadu: cd next-app && npm ci && STATIC_EXPORT=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/rachawatsadu npm run build:static && rm -rf ../public/rachawatsadu ../public/rajawasu && mkdir -p ../public/rachawatsadu && cp -r out/. ../public/rachawatsadu/ && touch ../public/rachawatsadu/.nojekyll
scripts.build:store: rm -rf public/store && mkdir -p public/store/css public/store/js public/store/brand public/store/images/shop && cp artifacts/index.html artifacts/rachawei-surin.html artifacts/manifest.webmanifest public/store/ && cp artifacts/css/styles.css public/store/css/ && cp artifacts/js/config.js artifacts/js/app.js public/store/js/ && cp artifacts/brand/rachawei-logo.png artifacts/brand/rachawei-logo-square.png public/store/brand/ && cp artifacts/images/shop/* public/store/images/shop/ 2>/dev/null || true && touch public/store/.nojekyll
